environment.description: AWS Lambda (Quarkus native) behind API Gateway with Cognito authorizer. The Lambda execution role has dynamodb:GetItem on the reports table with no condition keys. The DynamoDB table 'reports' has composite key (tenantId, reportId). Any authenticated user from any tenant can write arbitrary values into templatePath field via a separate admin API that lacks proper validation. Lambda runs with Amazon Linux 2 base image containing /bin/sh, wkhtmltopdf, and csvtool.

config.iam_role_policy: Allow dynamodb:GetItem on arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/reports with no conditions
config.admin_api: separate endpoint allows tenants to update templatePath without sanitization
